method.primaryEvidence: Independently opened every assigned saved PNG exactly once with functions.view_image, detail original; inspected its entire assigned width and height.
method.integrityEvidence: Read only the eight assigned PNG byte buffers to compute SHA-256 and inspect PNG signature and IHDR dimensions. All eight match the target manifest.
method.supportingEvidence: Existing matching DOM checks in the source report were read as supporting technical evidence only. They were not rerun and do not replace saved-pixel inspection.
method.authorizationAndLimitation: Explicitly authorized isolated headless offline display evidence, not formal headed product acceptance. No browser, native renderer, app, or retest was run in this review.
method.cropInterpretation: Targets are saved contiguous screenshot extracts with manifest top coordinates, not newly rendered standalone viewports. A glyph crossing a tile seam is distinguished from page-layout clipping. Original screenshot references are copied from the manifest; originals were not opened, hashed, decoded, or compared.
method.independence: Findings were made from these eight tile images, without other review findings, scientific text re-review, answer material, or author history.
method.scope: Only the eight exact assigned targets and their assigned right/bottom pixels. No verdict for another batch, whole card, whole mobile page, content accuracy, interactions, or headed acceptance.
